This approximately 3,600 square foot house features four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms. The primary bedroom suite includes a private en-suite bathroom and ample closet space. It also has access to the backyard. Three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for a variety of living situations. The three and a half bathrooms are conveniently located throughout the home, ensuring comfort and functionality. The open floor plan allows for seamless flow between the living areas, creating an inviting atmosphere. The homes layout can accommodate a range of furnishing and decor options to suit individual preferences. Ample storage and well-designed spaces make this property an ideal choice for those seeking a comfortable and versatile living environment. Coppell ISD top rated schools within walking distance of this amazing home.
